title.narrative: Establishing an Environment Fund for Kiribati

description.narrative: This project will provide technical assistance and capacity building training needed for the Environment Conservation Division (ECD) of Ministry of Environment, Lands and Agriculture Division (MELAD), to establish Kiribati´s Environment Fund, a financial mechanism expected to deliver long term, inclusive and effective solutions to adapt/mitigate climate change and build resilience.
